title: Home (main menu)
summary: The main menu: scene, top bar (avatar, coins, lives, gear), level plate, Play button and the 3-tab nav bar.
description: HomeView composes the home in SPEC-ui's z-order: the scene (backdrop + puppets, skin/scenes.json), the top bar (avatar -> Profile, coin pill -> Shop, lives pill, gear -> Settings), the LEVEL caption and plate, the Play button (normal / Hard / Super Hard looks) and the bottom nav (Shop / Home / Leaderboard tabs), and the home-return payout queue after a win (PayoutSequence: the ladder event's token, the streak step, coins flying into the pill; ui.json `homeReturn.*`). The event layer (badges, ladder bars), the Shop tab and the Leaderboard tab are other components wired in here. New files in App/Shell/Home are owned here unless another component names them.
